ADMIN.institute: Actual target institute resolved from User/Course; ADMIN has existing system-wide tenant authority, never request-claimed role authority.
ADMIN.relation: Target IDs must exist; nested IDs must resolve to that same persisted target. Role/permission changes additionally require real Admin password reauthentication and existing self-change constraints.
ADMIN.effects: User/session/password/permission writes, notifications and existing Admin audit inserts.

OWN.institute: Authenticated actor home institute; optional course must resolve through actual same-institute ownership/enrollment/assignment.
OWN.relation: User/session/settings/profile/notification/push registration resource.userId equals real actor.id; caller userId may not select another actor.
OWN.effects: Own-account or notification/session/profile mutations, external OAuth exchanges and storage operations.

COURSE_READ.institute: Course.instituteId equals selected supported/actual route institute; non-Admin actor home institute equals Course.instituteId. No institute route input means derive institute from the persisted Course.
COURSE_READ.relation: ADMIN system authority OR instructor alias with Course.instructorId=actor.id OR STUDENT with APPROVED Enrollment(courseId,actor.id). Enumerations constrain the query to those relationships, not post-filtering.
COURSE_READ.effects: Protected course/roster/syllabus/stream reads and response construction.

TEACH.institute: Actual course institute; instructors must have matching home institute. Admin retains system-wide scope.
TEACH.relation: Course.instructorId=actor.id for instructor aliases; child submission/item/announcement/group/rule/template must belong to that actual course. Target student must be an actual relevant enrollment/submission member.
TEACH.effects: Course/syllabus/announcement/grade/group/enrollment writes, attachments, incentives, exports, notifications, EXP/badges and revalidation.

STUDENT_WORK.institute: Actual syllabus/template/submission course institute equals actor home institute.
STUDENT_WORK.relation: APPROVED Enrollment and owned StudentSubmission/ActivitySession/ActivitySubmission/GithubSubmission where applicable; child IDs resolve to that same actual course and actor. No first-course/template synthesis fallback.
STUDENT_WORK.effects: Student submission/attachment/attempt/integrity/completion changes and resulting gamification/notifications/external snapshot work.

WORKSPACE.institute: Workspace record.instituteId=actor.homeInstitute; linked Course matches that institute.
WORKSPACE.relation: Personal Note/Task/Event creatorId=actor.id. For shared course CalendarEvent management require instructor alias plus Course.instructorId=actor.id, or ADMIN; student may manage only own personal events, never shared teaching schedules.
WORKSPACE.effects: Workspace notes/tasks/events create/update/delete and related ordering/completion changes.

FLASH.relation: Deck.creatorId=actor.id; Flashcard.deckId and progress/study session IDs resolve through that deck, progress.userId=actor.id; linked course requires APPROVED Enrollment.
FLASH.effects: Deck/card/progress/study completion writes and any approved external generation.

EXEC.institute: ICS only from actual actor institute, never program/institute payload. If a persisted template is used, its Course is also ICS.
EXEC.relation: Freeform execution is actor-owned code/session only. Persisted template execution additionally requires student APPROVED Enrollment/owned attempt or instructor assignment/Admin. Built-in catalog problem IDs must exist in real catalog; no arbitrary foreign course fallback.
EXEC.effects: Rate-limit allocation, code wrapping, Judge0/network/local fallback calls, evaluation, submission/grade/EXP effects only after authorization.

KX.institute: Actual actor institute ICS; linked post course must also be ICS with approved enrollment/assignment/Admin access.
KX.relation: Resolve answer/comment/vote/flag/bookmark/follow/revision through actual parent KxPost. Course-less ICS board content is accessible to recognized ICS members under existing status/deletion/visibility rules. Personal bookmark/follow/notification/vote ownership is actor.id; post/answer/comment edits/deletes require authorship or explicit moderator authority.
KX.effects: KX responses, creation/edit/deletion/voting/flagging/follows, notifications, EXP and external AI only after actual parent visibility/capability checks.

KX_MOD.institute: ICS moderator home institute; every target author/course belongs to ICS. ADMIN retains existing KX institute eligibility restriction.
KX_MOD.relation: Resolve moderation targets to actual parent post/author. Course-linked content requires instructor assignment or ADMIN. Course-less ICS board moderation permits ICS instructors/Admin under existing moderation contract. User-target sanctions require actual ICS target user, never a foreign or unrelated claimed user.
KX_MOD.effects: Moderation/sanction/deanonymization/private analytics reads, target writes, moderation audit and notifications.

GITHUB.institute: Actual repoLink owner institute and associated syllabus/post/course scope; no course/post link means own repoLink only.
GITHUB.relation: RepoLink.userId=actor.id for mutations; shared reads require actual linked course membership/assignment/Admin and stored visibility (instructor_only only authorized instructor/Admin; cohort only authorized cohort; anonymous existing masking retained). owner/repo/path/sha proxies must match a persisted authorized RepoLink; remote token belongs to the real actor. Child comment/CI/submission IDs resolve through that link.
GITHUB.effects: OAuth/repo/token/link/comment/submission writes and all outbound GitHub/tree/contents/commit/CI/similarity work after resource authorization.

MATERIAL.relation: APPROVED Enrollment; material annotation/completion/study entry belongs to actor and actual attachment/item/course. Delete annotation through annotation.userId and its actual parent.
MATERIAL.effects: Annotation/completion/study writes and any EXP/notification effects.

PERSONAL.institute: Actor home institute; linked course must be same-institute and approved enrollment.
PERSONAL.relation: Student gamification/progress/leaderboard-personal records belong to actor.id. Other identities only through approved normal-role aggregate/course scope and existing privacy opt-outs.

UPLOAD.institute: Actor home institute; any supplied syllabus/course/submission target must match its actual parent institute.
UPLOAD.relation: Staging upload belongs to actor.id; no client-selected owner/storage namespace. Attaching a returned file later requires the separate authorized teaching or owned student-submission boundary. Preserve legitimate staging uploads without inventing a mandatory courseId absent from current interface.
UPLOAD.effects: Multipart parsing, Blob/filesystem writes and publication only after actor role; bind subsequent attachment operations to authorized parent.

PROFILE_READ.institute: Target User institute matches actor home institute except system ADMIN scope.
PROFILE_READ.relation: Self OR ADMIN OR an instructor/student with actual shared authorized course relationship to the target. Read only the existing permitted normal-role profile contract; Super User has no third-party profile rights.
PROFILE_READ.effects: User/profile/enrollment/gamification response reads; no arbitrary cross-institute user ID query.

PUBLIC.institute: Public endpoint existing semantics; no Super User-specific or optional-auth privacy redesign.
PUBLIC.relation: No role grant; unchanged health/institutes/anonymous public leaderboard behavior. Never reuse these DTOs in authenticated oversight.

PUBLIC_AUTH.institute: Existing public auth schema and target account rules; self-registration never accepts ADMIN/SUPER_USER/UNKNOWN.
PUBLIC_AUTH.relation: Unauthenticated register/forgot/reset flow retains existing validation, reset proof and identity binding. A real active SUPER_USER attempting account management is denied before mutation; login itself and logout remain explicit exceptions.
PUBLIC_AUTH.effects: Account/password/reset-email/session changes only under existing valid public recovery/login protocol.

SUPPORT.institute: Login preserves existing home-portal rule; SUPER_USER starts ICS. me returns authenticated own identity, never selected institute mutation.
SUPPORT.relation: Login credentials resolve actual active account; logout revokes only real supplied/cookie session; me uses one real authenticated actor. UNKNOWN cannot become a protected actor.
SUPPORT.effects: Normal authenticated login/session creation/logout deletion and own identity response only.

SERVICE.institute: Service-owned persisted RepoLink records, not caller tenant claims.
SERVICE.relation: Existing GitHub webhook signature and delivery deduplication protocol; no actor-based fallback. Preserve service behavior and do not add product-role authorization to anonymous service traffic.
SERVICE.effects: Existing authorized webhook persistence/cache invalidation only after service proof.
